source_only_pair_grain: One unique (original study ID, normalized plant species binomial, exact ordered pair of WGS84 site coordinates). Multiple trait/rate rows sharing this key contribute one predictor geometry row; never select by effect size.
train_variance_weighting: One equal total weight per training plant species; each distinct source study/location pair within that species has equal subweight. Source effect row counts never used as analytical weights.
main_focal_history_predictor: Mean of the two sites' four-dimensional local 21ka-to-0BP standardised displacement magnitudes: Hpair=0.5*(sqrt(sum_j((C21ka(site1,j)-C0BP(site1,j))/s_j)^2)+sqrt(sum_j((C21ka(site2,j)-C0BP(site2,j))/s_j)^2)), where each s_j is the training-species-equal weighted SD of 0BP j at all pair endpoints, floored to one only when zero.
prespecified_information_estimator: Weighted residual sum of squares of Hpair from ordinary weighted least squares with intercept and 11 baseline controls, divided by weighted total Hpair centred sum of squares (train only); separate observation-weighted heldout ratio is descriptive and uses TRAIN-FITTED linear coefficients for prediction, not refitted on heldout.
outputs: number of unique study–species–coordinate pairs and deduplication factor
train/heldout species and study counts, within split nonzero historic predictor support
train unique-H fraction beyond contemporary climate+geographic geometry; heldout projection ratio descriptive
training species-equal distribution of H and effective residual historical signal species concentration
aggregate original present and glacial climate standardization only; no individual species/site climate
